def clean(df):
    # Remove exact duplicate rows
    df = df.drop_duplicates()
    
    # Standardize sex column (convert "FEMALE" to "female")
    df['sex'] = df['sex'].str.lower()
    
    # Clean body_mass_g - remove commas and convert to numeric
    df['body_mass_g'] = df['body_mass_g'].str.replace(',', '', regex=False).astype(float)
    
    # Filter out invalid body_mass_g values (out of range 2500-6500)
    df = df[(df['body_mass_g'] >= 2500) & (df['body_mass_g'] <= 6500)]
    
    # Filter out invalid flipper_length_mm values (out of range 170-235)
    df = df[(df['flipper_length_mm'] >= 170) & (df['flipper_length_mm'] <= 235)]
    
    return df

def answer(df):
    # Group by sex and calculate average body mass
    result = df.groupby('sex')['body_mass_g'].mean().to_dict()
    return result
